author: ArkhamJoshFTW
body:
So yea there is this cool thing that's a thing (love my grammar) called Karaoke Party. If you don't know already karaoke party is a website that has you sing to songs with the music and the lyrics. Anyway yea it's this http://www.karaokeparty.com/en/  
    Enjoy! peace
